title: Student movements focus more on education and jobs than electoral roll protests

ai.summary: Student movements in India are focusing on education and job issues rather than electoral roll protests, with youth prioritizing non-violent methods over the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) voter list updates.

facts.claim: Student movements focus more on education and jobs than electoral roll protests
facts.quote: Student movements focus more on education and jobs than electoral roll protests

facts.claim: Youth prioritize non-violent methods over the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) voter list updates
facts.quote: Allegations of external influence are addressed, emphasising that Indian youth act independently and maintain non-violent methods.
